description: This file defines a class 'SocketAwaitableEventArgs' that extends 'SocketAsyncEventArgs' to provide awaitable socket operation capabilities, integrating with async/await patterns in .NET. It manages continuations and scheduling for socket I/O completion handling within the Orleans project.

classes.name: SocketAwaitableEventArgs
classes.description: An awaitable wrapper around 'SocketAsyncEventArgs' that enables using C# async/await pattern with socket operations, managing continuations and scheduling for asynchronous socket events.

methods.name: GetAwaiter
methods.description: Returns the current instance as an awaiter for use with 'await'.

methods.name: IsCompleted
methods.description: Indicates whether the asynchronous operation has already completed.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Finalizes the await operation, throws socket exceptions if errors occurred, and returns the number of bytes transferred.

methods.name: OnCompleted
methods.description: Schedules the continuation action to be invoked upon completion of the socket operation, using the thread pool if needed.

methods.name: UnsafeOnCompleted
methods.description: Schedules the continuation action similarly to 'OnCompleted', used in scenarios requiring unsafe continuation scheduling.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Marks the socket operation as complete, triggering the continuation.

methods.name: OnCompleted (protected override)
methods.description: Invoked by the base class upon socket operation completion; schedules the continuation via the provided scheduler.
